contexts.text: By the product of the vine () is not meant must, or wine; but something celestial which is of the Lord's Kingdom. AC 9412:end.
When it has passed the breast, it becomes productive love.
As they grow up they conjoin themselves productively.
He closes the internal man... as to its productive love.
Every product and germ from the earth is Known by its flower and seed.
The product of the vine which they should drink new = the truth of the New Church and Heaven. ( = the Divine truth from Divine good, and the derivative bliss and happiness. AE 252:6.)

By the product of the vine, or the wine, which the Lord will drink new with them... when the Kingdom of God shall come, is meant that from His Divine Human is then all Divine truth in Heaven and in the Church; and therefore He calls it new.
